title: Cap Months for a Membership That Began or Ended Recently
content:
The cap months on which a Medicaid Managed Care Membership member's cost-sharing cap is figured follow how much of the counting window the membership covered. The cap months are the number of months of household income the cap is figured on.

## Interpretive note

1. **Membership that began recently.** Where the coverage start date falls fewer than the cap-period months before the review month, the cap months are one more than the whole months elapsed from the coverage start date to the review date. This applies when that count, one more than the whole months elapsed, is itself fewer than the category's cap-period months.
2. **Membership that has ended.** Where the membership has ended and its termination date falls inside the counting window, the cap months are the cap-period months less the whole months from the termination date to the review date. The termination date falls inside the counting window when it lies fewer than the cap-period months, in whole months, before the review date.
3. **Every other membership.** Otherwise the cap months are the category's cap-period months.

The descriptions are read in the order given, and the first one that fits the membership decides the cap months.

Terms: the review date is the date the cap is worked out; the counting window is the number of months in the category's cap period counted back from the review date, a date counting when it lies fewer than that many whole months before the review date; whole months elapsed are complete calendar months between the two dates.

## Month counts (hypothetical dates)

Every date below is invented for illustration.

| Cap-period months | Membership facts | Whole months counted | Cap months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | Coverage start 14 November 2025, review 20 March 2026 | 4 elapsed since coverage start | 5 (one more than 4, and 5 is fewer than 12) |
| 3 | Coverage start 25 January 2026, review 20 March 2026 | 1 elapsed since coverage start | 2 (one more than 1, and 2 is fewer than 3) |
| 3 | Coverage start 5 January 2026, review 20 March 2026 | 2 elapsed since coverage start | 3 (one more than 2 is 3, which is not fewer than 3; the membership has not ended, so the cap-period months apply) |
| 12 | Coverage start two years earlier; membership ended 10 January 2026, review 20 March 2026 | 2 from termination date to review date | 10 (12 less 2) |
| 3 | Coverage start two years earlier; membership ended 10 October 2025, review 20 March 2026 | 5 from termination date to review date | 3 (the termination date lies outside the counting window) |
| 12 | Coverage start two years earlier; membership open | none needed | 12 |
